name: Go'Shek Farm
summary: Go'Shek Farm gathers food and livestock for Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Forsaken apothecaries also work there in secret.

sections.title: A Horde Outpost in the East
sections.body: South of Hammerfall, Go'Shek Farm lies just north of hostile Witherbark troll territory. The Horde holds the farm, and Hammerfall Grunts patrol its fields and stables. Its food and livestock help the orcish settlement keep its foothold in the Arathi Highlands.

sections.title: The Apothecary's Workshop
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society keeps a quiet presence at Go'Shek Farm, led by figures such as Apothecary Jorell. Couriers carry notes, reagents, and research between the farm and Tarren Mill, studying early forms of the Forsaken's new plague. Alliance scouts seek to intercept the messengers and learn what poison is being prepared in the Arathi soil.

faq.q: Why is the Horde occupying Go'Shek Farm?
aliases: why are orcs at goshek farm
faq.answer: Go'Shek Farm supplies food and livestock to nearby Hammerfall. It also gives the Forsaken a guarded place for sensitive chemical and alchemical research.

faq.q: Who used to own this farm?
faq.answer: The farm's earlier owners are not recorded. Today, orcs from nearby Hammerfall work and guard it for the Horde.

faq.q: What kind of experiments are happening here?
faq.answer: Forsaken apothecaries conduct secretive alchemical work at the farm. Alliance agents investigate courier traffic and records there to learn its nature.

faq.q: Why are there Alliance agents watching the farm?
faq.answer: Quae and Kinelory investigate suspicious traffic between Go'Shek Farm and Tarren Mill. They seek evidence of the Forsaken's activities and need help reaching it.

angles.text: The farm supplies Hammerfall and houses Forsaken apothecaries whose secretive work has drawn Alliance scrutiny.
Keeping Go'Shek Farm secure helps provision Hammerfall and guard its perimeter against the encroaching Witherbark trolls.
